text:
maria: Heads up — during the automated token audit we found privilege drift on the infra-admin role. Several service accounts picked up additional permissions yesterday. Opening a remediation ticket now.

devsec-bot: [ALERT] privilege-drift detected for group=infra-admin; changed_by=svc-ci-bot; change_ts=1913745000; see /logs/privilege-drift/1913745000.log :warning:

omkar: can you paste the IAM diff or the PR that introduced it? want to confirm scope before we rotate anything.

maria: quick diff attached in ticket https://redwood-internal/issue/4521 — top-level summary: added iam.roles.editor to 3 svc accounts (svc-deploy, svc-metrics, svc-ml-train). snippet:
```
- svc-deploy: roles/viewer
+ svc-deploy: roles/viewer, roles/editor
```
not sure if CI policy merged it or someone manually patched.

liam: I can own rotation for the svc-deploy and svc-metrics accounts. Plan: 1) create new keys, 2) update deployments, 3) revoke old keys, 4) validate. ETA EOD tomorrow if no blockers. :hourglass: 

sanjay: I’ll take audit & guardrail tasks — re-enable strict IAM change alerts, add an allowlist for service accounts that can receive editor-level perms, and schedule a weekly drift check. Will need entitlements list from infra.

anya: suggest adding a one-click rollback to the runbook and a short checklist for oncall so rotations don't break builds. I can draft the runbook update this afternoon.

maria: thanks — assigning owners in ticket 4521: liam (rotation), sanjay (audit & guardrails), anya (runbook). tagging @omkar for review of the PR/CI pipeline rules that allowed this.

omkar: on it. quick look shows an automated migration job that had an overly broad patch in CI templates. I’ll revert the template and file a follow-up PR that forces explicit role additions. linking PR: https://redwood-internal/pr/9876

devsec-bot: [ACTION CREATED] Incident follow-up created: https://redwood-internal/incident/4521 assigned=[liam,sanjay,anya] due=1913834605

liam: rotation checklist (short):
- create new service account keys (gcloud iam service-accounts keys create)
- update k8s secret manifests and apply
- rollout deployments with canary 10% -> 100%
- revoke old keys after 1 successful canary run

sanjay: audit tasks:
- enable detailed admin audit logging for iam.* events
- run historical difference tool `scripts/iam-drift --since 7d`
- add daily drift report to infra slack channel

anya: runbook additions:
- troubleshooting section for failed deploys after rotation
- rollback fast-path (reapply old secret)
- contact list for owners and SRE oncall

maria: timeline check: liam aims EOD tomorrow for rotations, omkar will revert CI template within 4 hours, sanjay starts guardrails today and targets weekly checks by next Monday, anya will publish runbook update today. If any ETA slips, post updates in this thread.

omkar: reverted template, PR opened to lock role changes: https://redwood-internal/pr/9877 — CI will now block role edits that aren't reviewed. :white_check_mark:

liam: started key creation for svc-deploy. will run canary in 30m.

maria: great. please drop canary results here. once all good I'll close the incident follow-up.

devsec-bot: [REMINDER scheduled] follow-up review in 72h for incident 4521 -> reminder posted to #incidents at 1914011405

liam: canary succeeded, no regressions. revoking old keys now. :thumbsup:

maria: confirmed. marking remediation step complete in ticket and scheduling a 2-week retro to check recurrence patterns. thanks everyone.
